sections.Profile:
The "Go-Cart" pinball machine, produced by J.H. Keeney & Co. in May 1963, is an electro-mechanical game designed for single-player enjoyment. The playfield features two flippers, three pop bumpers, five passive bumpers, two slingshots, six standup targets, and two rollover buttons. The backglass art reflects the go-cart racing theme, capturing the excitement of the sport

- Manufacturer: Keeney and Sons
- Years made: 1963
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Go karts, Single Player, Racing, Original Theme, Recreation, Cars
